claim: A normal Omarchy user can recover an already configured NetworkManager link before launching an Agent, while a missing route remains classified by the existing smoke probe.
oracle: The default command is read-only; an explicit reconnect selects only a saved device of the requested transport, never creates a profile or prints credentials, and then reports route, DNS and HTTPS status.

user_journey.scenario: The user opens an Agent after Wi-Fi coverage or USB sharing was interrupted, runs the recovery command, and retries the workload.
user_journey.expected: A saved connection is retried when explicitly requested; if recovery cannot produce a route, the output identifies the failing layer and keeps the operator's next action clear.

invariants: --reconnect accepts only wifi, usb, cellular or any and uses an existing device; it never creates a profile or accepts a password.
Device and transport output is sanitized; SSIDs, MAC addresses, credentials, IMEI and full routes are not printed.
The existing bounded Agent probe remains the final oracle for address, DNS and HTTPS.
gitnexus: The package install boundary stages the recovery wrapper beside the same Agent probe used by the host tools copy.
No boot, modem, calibration, slot-success or flash path imports the wrapper.
ast: The only NetworkManager mutation is nmcli device connect after an explicit --reconnect argument.
The wrapper delegates all endpoint checks and retry bounds to agent-network-smoke.

unit.red: The package had a read-only diagnostic but no supported way to retry a saved connection after a transient link loss.
unit.green: Fixtures cover a disconnected Wi-Fi device, explicit reconnect, delegation to the smoke probe and output redaction.
cases: default check does not call nmcli connect

boundaries: Omarchy shell -> NetworkManager saved device -> DHCP/DNS/HTTPS
evidence: Offline fixture and package tests pass; live Pixel 6 normal-desktop execution remains pending.

limitations: The wrapper cannot create Wi-Fi credentials, infer an APN or repair a missing kernel driver/firmware.
Cellular reconnect may incur carrier data usage and is intentionally operator initiated.
A successful smoke probe does not prove an authenticated Agent API request.
exit_gate: Run --check after a cold normal Omarchy boot, then explicitly reconnect the authorized Wi-Fi or USB path after one controlled disconnect and rerun one Agent API request.
